posts.title: Mobile Single-Trucker Departs Maine
posts.description: The Seashore Trolley Museum posted yesterday on Facebook the happy conclusion to one of their "re-homing" stories. Mobile Light & Railroad 49 , pictured above on a flatbed ready to depart Kennebunkport, has been acquired for preservation in North Carolina. posts.title: A New Home for Public Service 2651
posts.description: Today Public Service Coordinated Transport 2651 , one of only two standard cars from the Public Service Railway system in New Jersey and the last intact example of the line's distinctive "compromise roof" cars, was transported to its new home at Branford.
